text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? I won? Against... Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I did it... I really did it! I truly gave it my all! Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm not like Ayabe. I have no one
to offer
this star to.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can, can't I? Then, I'll take this star and
give it
to...
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure we'll find one if we look.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... is that so? Then...
choice_data_list: 同期はヘンじゃないか？

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it to you, Trainer. Please, before
it gets
cold...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But why nooot?
choice_data_list: いえいえ、さすがに受け取れません
choice_data_list_en: No, no, I couldn't possibly accept this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you... doing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ack?! Ayabe! Well, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for... getting in your way. But this
was a
really important match to me, so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to apologize. I'm not
bothered.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I lost because I was too weak. That's all
there is to
it. See you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh... And you ran well, Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Ayabe wasn't upset with me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I might have won today, but...
Hopefully,
someday...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll be able to run like she does—for the
sake of
someone else.

Admire Vega looks up at a daytime star,

undeterred in the face of her broken
dreams.
Meisho Doto, quietly from
behind, sends her off
with a polite bow
of respect.
